customer: how much for gents shalwar kameez stitching?
reply: Stitching a gents shalwar kameez costs Rs 1,800, and it takes 10 days.

customer: I need 2 suits stitched urgently for a wedding next week, is that possible?? how much extra
reply: Yes, urgent stitching is done in 4 days for Rs 800 extra. A 50% advance of the stitching charge is required when you drop off the fabric.

customer: Do I have to come to the shop for measurements or can I just send my old suit with my brother
reply: Measurements are taken at the shop, or you can give us an old suit that fits you well and we will stitch to that.

customer: are u open on friday? only day i can come
reply: Sorry, we are closed on Friday. We are open Saturday to Thursday from 11am to 9pm.

customer: Do you do hand embroidery or adda work on ladies suits? What would that cost?
reply: A ladies suit with lace or piping starts at Rs 2,200, but our policy does not cover embroidery or hand work. Our team will contact you shortly.

customer: can you deliver the stitched suits to my house near Bosan Road? hard for me to come again
reply: Stitching takes 10 days, but we don't have information about home delivery. Our team will contact you shortly.

customer: واسکٹ کی سلائی کتنے کی ہے؟
reply: واسکٹ کی سلائی Rs 3,500 کی ہے، اور سلائی میں 10 دن لگتے ہیں۔

reply: جی، عید سے 15 دن پہلے تک نئے آرڈر لیے جاتے ہیں، اس لیے آپ ابھی کپڑا دے سکتے ہیں۔ عام سلائی میں 10 دن لگتے ہیں۔

customer: bhai kameez ki fitting tight hai, 3 din pehle li thi, alteration ke paise lagenge kya?
reply: Delivery ke 7 din ke andar fitting ki alteration free hai, is liye aap ke koi paise nahi lagenge. Aap suit dukaan par le aayein.
